content:
Apple's most important product launch event of the year is approaching, with more than ten new products set to be unveiled in a short period. Below are the five brand-new Apple products I am most looking forward to.

iPhone Ultra

The first foldable iPhone is about to debut, offering the experience of both an iPhone and an iPad mini on a single device — a thrilling prospect.

Even though numerous hardware details have already leaked, the software on the iPhone Ultra will be key to whether the overall experience can truly shine. I am therefore very eager to see how Apple transforms iOS 27 into a system that runs natively on a foldable device, with even more powerful capabilities.

I have never used a foldable smartphone before, but from everything I have seen, this product form factor appears to be the future. Apple has clearly thought long and hard before entering the foldable market, and I have high hopes that it will have been worth the wait.

HomePad

For years I have been hoping Apple would take the smart home market seriously. It was not until Mark Gurman first reported in detail at the end of 2024 on the upcoming "HomePad" that I realised this shift was about to happen.

Every feature of the HomePad piques my interest, including Apple Photos slideshow playback, security camera functionality, Siri AI, and synchronised lyrics display when playing Apple Music, among others.

Delays to Siri AI have caused the HomePad to take longer to arrive than expected. But all signs point to an imminent launch, and I am ready to witness how Apple, through the HomePad and other new home products, will chart a vision for a new era of smart home living.

A brand-new Apple TV 4K

The current Apple TV 4K has been on the market for four years. Although this product does not need to be updated every year, the rise of AI technology offers tremendous potential for a complete overhaul of the experience.

I look forward to seeing how Siri AI, a more powerful chip, and other hardware and software upgrades come together to make this Apple TV upgrade worthwhile.

With the HomePad equipped with a camera launching around the same time as the new Apple TV 4K, I am also very curious whether earlier rumours about a built-in camera model will come true. Being able to make FaceTime calls on the big screen without needing an iPhone would be extremely convenient in the future.

MacBook Ultra

I have been using the iPad Pro as my main computer for over a decade. One of the main reasons I decided to make the switch in 2015 was that the Mac always lagged behind the iPad in terms of innovative hardware and software features.

After Apple Silicon chips were applied to the Mac, some of these issues were partially resolved, and macOS has increasingly been updated in sync with iOS and iPadOS. However, the Mac still feels stuck in the past in many ways, rather than oriented towards the future.

I expect the MacBook Ultra will change that. Introducing touch support, an OLED display, Dynamic Island, an entirely new design, and possibly even a cellular version for the Mac — each of these is extremely appealing. This is the Mac update I have been waiting for, and I cannot wait to see the full picture of what Apple is about to unveil.

Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4

I have not yet decided whether to choose the Series 12 or the Ultra 4 this year. However, regardless of which one I pick, I am very much looking forward to the arrival of the new models — primarily because of one rumoured major upgrade: a brand-new S-series chip designed for the AI era.

Apple Watch chips are not replaced very often. Although Apple makes small improvements to the S-series chip every year, CPU performance only sees a significant boost roughly every three years. The last notable jump in chip performance was therefore the S9 back in 2023.

However, reports suggest this year's watch models will feature a more powerful, entirely new chip — the first designed for the AI era — and the timing could not be better, coinciding with the rollout of Siri AI.

Which upcoming Apple product are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments.
